excerpt.zh:
我们应该考虑[GetBuildingGrowing]第二艘£science_ship£科研船来加速星系的探索进度。

点击恒星基地选择船坞选项卡。再在几个选项中选择科研船。

excerpt.en:
We should consider [GetBuildingGrowing] a second £science_ship£ Science Ship to increase the speed at which we survey our region of the galaxy.

Click on our Starbase and select the Shipyard tab, then select Science Ship from among the available choices.

texts.en:
We should consider [GetBuildingGrowing] a second £science_ship£ Science Ship to increase the speed at which we survey our region of the galaxy.

Click on our Starbase and select the Shipyard tab, then select Science Ship from among the available choices.

Note that you will need to have amassed enough £alloys£ Alloys to afford the Ship before its construction can begin.
